response.sql:
WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT p.ID,
           p.SEX,
           AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
           AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT patient_stats.*,
           AVG(ratio) OVER () AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT ID AS patient_id,
       SEX AS sex,
       avg_wbc,
       ratio,
       ratio - mean_ratio AS ratio_minus_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND ratio > mean_ratio
ORDER BY ratio_minus_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The patient's HGB/HCT ratio is the average of the per-record HGB/HCT ratios, excluding records with missing HGB or HCT and treating a zero HCT as undefined. The overall mean is then the unweighted mean of those patient ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each patient's ratio from their separately averaged HGB and HCT values (excluding missing values in each average), rather than averaging record-level ratios.
